description: T2I_main upscale paths. `latent` is the native Krea 2 refine pass; `esrgan` is the optional 4x-UltraSharp post-pass. `none` disables upscaling.

upscalers.label: No upscale
upscalers.notes: Decode the base latent at the requested size and save it directly.

upscalers.label: Latent refine (Krea 2 native)

valueRange.label: Refine size
valueRange.description: Long side of the refined latent. The model's refine.scale range is authoritative for this path.

upscalers.notes: Default Freeze v8 path: LatentUpscale (nearest-exact) to 1536 long side, then a 6-step / CFG 2.0 / denoise 0.45 refine pass.

upscalers.label: 4x-UltraSharp (ESRGAN)

valueRange.label: Output size
valueRange.description: Long side after the 4x model. 4x-UltraSharp first produces 4x pixels, then ImageScale downsizes to this value. Keep it at or below 3072 on 12 GB.

upscalers.notes: Optional ESRGAN block. This is an alternative to latent refine, not a second pass; the selected upscale path is one of none, latent refine or 4x-UltraSharp.
